title: Are we getting closer to ‘waking up’?
content: Has anyone else recently felt like you’re getting closer to ‘figuring something out’? Or even just more antsy and ‘awake’ in day to day life. My dreams and friends dreams have been OFF THE CHARTS weird and lucid and specific. I feel like I’m constantly in a state of anxiety now and most of my friends who don’t get anxiety are starting to get it around bed time when trying to sleep. Just thinking of theories. It’s weird and starting to make me feel like I’m insane. I’ve never had panic attacks and now it’s every single night, not to mention anxiety attacks in my dreams too. Curious on thoughts.
